description: This file contains unit tests for the AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer, which checks for conflicting alias attributes in Orleans-related code elements such as enums, records, classes, structs, interfaces, and methods. It uses Xunit for testing and verifies that the analyzer correctly identifies conflicts and non-conflicts in various scenarios.

classes.name: AliasClashAttributeAnalyzerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AliasClashAttributeAnalyzer, testing detection of alias conflicts in various code constructs.

methods.name: VerifyHasDiagnostic
methods.description: Asserts that the provided code triggers a diagnostic from the analyzer.

methods.name: VerifyHasNoDiagnostic
methods.description: Asserts that the provided code does not trigger any diagnostics from the analyzer.

methods.name: Enum_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate alias on enums triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: Record_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate alias on records triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: RecordStruct_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate alias on record structs triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: Class_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate alias on classes triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: Struct_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate alias on structs triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: GrainInterface_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate alias on various grain interfaces triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: NonGrainInterface_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate alias on non-grain interfaces does not trigger a diagnostic.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceMethod_ShouldTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that duplicate method alias within a grain interface triggers a diagnostic.

methods.name: GrainInterfaceMethod_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that different method aliases within a grain interface do not trigger a diagnostic.

methods.name: DifferentGrainInterfaceMethod_ShouldNotTriggerDiagnostic
methods.description: Test that same method alias in different grain interfaces does not trigger a diagnostic.
